sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Spline
  • 한 줄 정체성: 웹 인터랙티브 3D 디자인 툴 — 브라우저에서 직접 모델링·애니메이션
  • 공식 디자인 철학: “3D와 디자인을 위한 올인원 플랫폼” — 복잡한 3D 제작과 웹 배포를 익숙한 디자인 도구의 흐름으로 단순화
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 중립적인 에디터 캔버스 위에 떠 있는 컬러 3D 오브젝트와, 좌측 아웃라이너·상단 툴바·우측 프로퍼티 패널의 공간형 작업 구조
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 3D웹, 보라그라데이션, 인터랙티브
  • 무드 설명: 라이트와 다크를 모두 지원하는 중립 UI 위에서 보라·블루·핑크 재질의 3D 오브젝트가 주인공이 된다. 둥근 패널과 절제된 경계, 부드러운 명암으로 전문 도구의 밀도와 유희적인 공간감을 함께 만든다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 글래스모피즘
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (10~14px)
  • 평면성: Layered

:root {

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 600 13px/1 'Spline Sans', 'Pretendard', sans-serif; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 120ms ease; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-400); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); }
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.btn.loading::before { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-right-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 700ms linear infinite; }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-default); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-primary-50); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }
.btn-play { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-500), var(--color-secondary-500)); color: #fff; padding: 10px 18px; }
.btn-tool { width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-default); }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

Input

.input { background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 12px/1.3 inherit; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary-500); background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(94,92,230,0.14); }
.input.error { border-color: var(--color-error-fg); background: var(--color-error-bg); }
.input:disabled { color: var(--text-disabled); cursor: not-allowed; }

Card (Inspector glass + Object)

.glass { background: var(--bg-elevated); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.glass .head { font: 700 11px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.glass .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px; font: 500 12px/1 inherit; }
.glass .row label { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.scene-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 12px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.scene-item:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
.scene-item.selected { background: rgba(94,92,230,0.14); color: var(--color-primary-600); }
.scene-item .ic { width: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.card.outlined { box-shadow: none; }
.card.featured { border-color: var(--color-primary-300); box-shadow: var(--shadow-violet); }

Badge / Tag

.tag { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 11px/1.4 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.tag-mesh     { background: rgba(94,92,230,0.14); color: var(--color-primary-600); }
.tag-light    { background: rgba(255,184,79,0.16); color: var(--color-warning-fg); }
.tag-event    { background: rgba(64,165,255,0.16); color: var(--color-info-fg); }
.tag-export   { background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-fg); }
.tag-beta     { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-500), var(--color-secondary-500)); color: #fff; }

Navigation (Top bar)

.topbar { background: var(--bg-elevated); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); padding: 10px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
.topbar .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 700 16px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.topbar .brand .dot { width: 18px; height: 18px; background: #151519; color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 10px; }
.topbar .tools { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.topbar .right { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font: 500 12px/1 inherit; }
sections.⑪: 1. 컬러 3D 오브젝트만 남기고 아웃라이너·툴바·프로퍼티 패널의 에디터 문맥을 제거하지 않는다. 2. 오브젝트를 단색의 평면 도형처럼 처리하지 않는다 — 재질·광원·공간 그림자로 깊이를 만든다. 3. 모든 UI 면을 네온 보라로 채우지 않는다 — 중립적인 라이트/다크 면 위에 Violet을 선택과 실행 상태로 제한한다. 4. Hover·Drag·Play 같은 상호작용 단서를 생략하지 않는다 — 정지 이미지가 아닌 실시간 도구의 인상을 유지한다. 5. 장식적인 세리프를 에디터 본문에 사용하지 않는다 — Spline Sans와 가독성 높은 한글 산세리프를 사용한다.
sections.⑫:
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: 'Spline Sans', 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
  .spline-demo { height: 480px; padding: 10px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 42px minmax(0,1fr) 82px; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .sd-topbar { position: relative; top: auto; z-index: 5; min-width: 0; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .sd-topbar .brand { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 14px; }
  .sd-topbar .brand .dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; }
  .sd-file { min-width: 0; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .sd-tools { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-left: auto; }
  .sd-tool { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 600 12px/1 inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out), color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
  .sd-tool:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .sd-tool.active { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #FFFFFF; }
  .sd-topbar .btn { padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 11px; }

  .sd-editor { min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0,1fr) 190px; gap: 8px; }
  .sd-panel { min-height: 0; padding: 10px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .sd-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin: 0 2px 8px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .sd-panel-head b { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .sd-outliner .scene-item { padding: 6px 7px; margin-bottom: 1px; font-size: 10px; }
  .sd-outliner .scene-item.indent { padding-left: 20px; }
  .sd-outliner .scene-item.selected { background: rgba(94,92,230,.14); color: var(--color-primary-600); }
  .sd-eye { margin-left: auto; width: 11px; height: 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; opacity: .52; }
  .sd-cube-icon { width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(30deg); }

  .sd-canvas { position: relative; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, rgba(94,92,230,.12), transparent 35%), var(--bg-canvas); }
  .sd-canvas::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10%; right: -10%; bottom: -55%; height: 100%; background-image: linear-gradient(var(--border-default) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-default) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size: 30px 30px; opacity: .42; transform: perspective(260px) rotateX(62deg); transform-origin: top; }
  .sd-canvas-tools { position: absolute; z-index: 4; top: 10px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .sd-canvas-tools .sd-tool { width: 25px; height: 25px; font-size: 11px; }
  .sd-scene-name { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 12px; top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; }
  .sd-scene-name i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #46C885; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-success-bg); }
  .sd-art { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: min(390px,80%); height: 90%; filter: drop-shadow(0 20px 22px rgba(43,35,104,.18)); transform: translateY(4px); }
  .sd-selection { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: min(280px,58%); height: 66%; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-500); transform: translate(-50%,-45%); pointer-events: none; }
  .sd-selection i { position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-500); background: var(--bg-elevated); }
  .sd-selection i:nth-child(1) { left: -4px; top: -4px; } .sd-selection i:nth-child(2) { right: -4px; top: -4px; } .sd-selection i:nth-child(3) { right: -4px; bottom: -4px; } .sd-selection i:nth-child(4) { left: -4px; bottom: -4px; }
  .sd-orbit { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 10px; z-index: 4; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-tertiary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); font-size: 9px; }
  .sd-zoom { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; z-index: 4; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 9px; }

  .sd-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .sd-tab { padding: 5px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 650; text-align: center; }
  .sd-tab.active { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .sd-prop-section { padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
  .sd-prop-section:first-of-type { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; }
  .sd-prop-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
  .sd-axis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr 12px 1fr; gap: 4px; align-items: center; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 8px; }
  .sd-axis .input { min-width: 0; padding: 4px 5px; font-size: 9px; }
  .sd-material { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 25px 1fr; gap: 7px; align-items: center; }
  .sd-swatch { width: 25px; height: 25px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#B9A9FF,#7867EF 48%,#4432A4); box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.25); }
  .sd-material strong { display: block; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 9px; }
  .sd-material small { color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 8px; }
  .sd-event { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 7px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-info-bg); color: var(--color-info-fg); font-size: 9px; }

  .sd-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; }
  .sd-feature { min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; }
  .sd-feature-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-600); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
  .sd-feature:nth-child(2) .sd-feature-icon { background: var(--color-info-bg); color: var(--color-info-fg); }
  .sd-feature:nth-child(3) .sd-feature-icon { background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-fg); }
  .sd-feature strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .sd-feature p { margin: 3px 0 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .sd-editor { grid-template-columns: 120px minmax(0,1fr); }
    .sd-properties { display: none; }
    .sd-file { max-width: 120px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .spline-demo { padding: 7px; gap: 6px; grid-template-rows: 40px minmax(0,1fr) 72px; }

    .sd-feature-icon { margin: auto; }
    .sd-feature p { display: none; }
  }
</style>
